29352132.axellos: inget totalmått i källan; bara delmått: Specification rows of the product page: voltage 12V, 9.2A; flow 17 l/min; inlet size 3/4 inch hose barb, thread; outlet size 3/4 inch hose barb, thread; type 3-chamber diaphragm; self-priming 6 ft [within 2 m]; inlet pressure max 40 PSI [2.76 bar]; dry running yes; net weight 2.4 kg; title: water pressure diaphragm pump, 12V, high-pressure diaphragm water pump, 2.7 bar (40 PSI) automatic self-priming water pump, 17 L/MIN mist-spraying diaphragm pump for caravan, boat, motorhome, garden; bullets: a diaphragm water pump made of high-strength cast iron with a powder coating that is waterproof and rustproof; a fully automatic self-priming pump with a max flow of 17 L/min, an inlet pressure set to max 40 PSI (2.76 bar) and a pump power of DC 12V; a built-in thermal protection and automatic pressure protection; a small size and light weight for quick installation
